actions.name: neutral
actions.description: Submit one neutral frame while preserving current HMD and controller poses.

actions.name: accept
actions.description: Pulse the right OpenVR trigger button.

actions.name: back
actions.description: Pulse the right OpenVR application-menu button.

actions.name: move-forward
actions.description: Hold the left primary axis forward for a bounded interval.

actions.name: move-back
actions.description: Hold the left primary axis backward for a bounded interval.

actions.name: turn-left
actions.description: Pulse the right primary axis left.

actions.name: turn-right
actions.description: Pulse the right primary axis right.

actions.name: axis-pulse
actions.description: Pulse a selected OpenVR controller axis with explicit x/y values.

actions.name: button-pulse
actions.description: Pulse an explicit OpenVR controller button mask.

actions.name: key-tap
actions.description: Tap a named DevBench keyboard key.
